verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec from INPI. The docs cover filing procedures and searchable databases, and the probe shows only that data.inpi.fr returns 403 to keyless requests. An IP office with an open-data portal could plausibly publish an API spec, so the axis applies, but nothing here shows one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
